highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update, including upstream Chrome fixes.
highlights_body: Linux font fallback can select a different face after this update; use an explicit or bundled typeface when deterministic text metrics matter.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path. Applications that depend on an exact fontconfig fallback face may see different glyphs or text metrics; specify an explicit family and style, or use a bundled typeface, when selection must be deterministic.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Skia m153 and incorporates the corresponding upstream Chrome fixes without changing the managed API surface.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opens the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and upstream Chrome fixes.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 brings the Skia m153 engine update to the new release line.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: The release incorporates upstream Chrome fixes while preserving the managed API surface. Linux applications relying on a particular fontconfig fallback face should use an explicit or bundled typeface.
